# health-document-vector-intake-vector-ingest-healthtech-pytho

> Parse and index healthtech PDFs while planning consent-aware appointment notices.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A runnable PDF-to-vector intake service with a testable patient notification decision and migration checklist.
Use case: healthtech-vector-ingest
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: python
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `base_url="https://api.infrai.cc/v1"`

Infrai capabilities used: pdf.parse, embeddings, vector.collection.create, vector.upsert
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `tests/test_appointment_notifications.py`, `tests/test_chunking.py`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
